Slice B is landed at 7dcbffa, bd-01M16WY7ZW1K3ZNDK14VPVAK90 is closed, and the reservation on CodecGens.scala + InterviewInductionSuite.scala is pure residue blocking new-engineer's slice E until its 15:57Z TTL. new-engineer has asked twice, I have asked twice, and you are the only actor who can act.

No fault -- mote gives you no prompt on close, and this is trap 1 in the onboarding sticky for exactly that reason. Prefer 'mote done' over 'mote close' next time; it releases and closes together.
